verses.transcription: bismil ilaahi ikfinil akdaara yal laahu

verses.text: صَفِّ الْبَقَآءَ بِهِ لِى فِيكَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: saffil baqaa-a bihi lii fiika yal laahu

verses.text: يَامَنْ لَّهُ الْأَمْرُ يَامَنْ لَّاشَرِيكَ لَهُ
verses.transcription: yaa man lahul amru yaa man laashariika lahu
wassih wa mallik wa atliq fiika yal laahu
waajahtukal yawma yaa rahmaanu murtajiyan

verses.text: فَوْزِى بِمَا ثِئْتُ فِى دُنْيَاكَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: fawzii bimaa si-tu fii dunyaaka yal laahu
antar rahiimul lazii arjuu birahmatihi

verses.text: أَنْ لَّآ أُلَاقِىَ ضُرًّا مِّنْكَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: an laa ulaaqiya durran minka yal laahu
mallik yamiinii wa qalbis su-la yaa malikii
bilaa hisaabin bijuudin minka yal laahu
qaddasta sirriya yaa qudduusu murtadiyan
hannii wa hanka radiitud dahra yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ الَّذِى سَلَّمْتَ كُلِّىَ مِنْ
verses.transcription: antas salaamul lazii sallamta kulliya min
huyuubi nafsii bitayyin minka yal laahu

verses.text: يَامُومِنُ اكْفِ جَنَابِى الضُّرَّ مَعْ كَدَرٍ
verses.transcription: yaa muuminu ikfi janaabid durra mah kadarin

verses.text: وَهَبْ لِىَ الْأَمْنَ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: wa hab liyal amna fid daarayni yal laahu
wa bil muhaymini lish had bishtiraa-ika maa

verses.text: قَدْ بِعْتُ سِرًّا إِلَى الْجَنَّاتِ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: qad bihtu sirran ilal jannati yal laahu
antal haziizul lazii abghii bihizzatihi
hizzan yukhalidu lit takriima yal laahu

verses.text: أَجْبَرْتَ لِى إِنَّكَ الْجَبَّارُ دُونَ لِقَآ
verses.transcription: ajbarta lii innakal jabbaaru duuna liqaa

verses.text: كُلَّ الْعِدَى بِالَّذِى لِى اخْتَرْتَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: kullal hidaa bil lazii likh tarta yal laahu

verses.text: كَفَيْتَنِى كُلَّ ذِى كِبْرِ بِلَا كُلَفٍ
verses.transcription: kafaytanii kulla zii kibri bilaa kulafin
yaa mutakabbiru rudtal kulla yal laahu

verses.text: يَاخَالِقَ الْخَلْقِ لِى اخْلُقْ مَآ أَشَآ أَبَدًا
verses.transcription: yaa khaaliqal khalqi likh luq maa ashaa abadan
bil bishri was safwi war ridwaani yal laahu

verses.text: يَابَارِىءَ الْخَلْقِ قُدْ لِى النَّفْعَ دُونَ أَذًى
verses.transcription: yaa baarii-al khalqi qud lin nafha duuuna azan
wa qud liyal ajra lil jannaati yal laahu
antal musawwiru khallid lin nabii bushran
wa sawwiran liya duunal makri yal laahu

verses.text: غَفَرْتَ لِى كُلَّ ذَنْبٍ قَدْ أَتَيْتُ بِهِ
verses.transcription: ghafarta lii kulla zanbin qad ataytu bihi
lish had bishukriya yaa ghaffaaru yal laahu

verses.text: قَهَرْتَ لِى رَبِّ أَعْدَآءِى بِلَا سَبَبٍ
verses.transcription: qaharta lii rabbi ahdaa-ii bilaa sababin
minnii hamidttuka yaa qahhaaru yal laahu

verses.text: وَهَبْتَ لِى مِنْكَ سُؤْلًا فَاقَ مَسْئَلَتِى
verses.transcription: wa habta lii minka su-lan faaqa mas-alatii
falaka shukriya yaa wahhaabu yal laahu

verses.text: لِى قُدْتَّ أَثْمَانَ لَجْ يَامَنْ لَّهُ عُمُرِى
verses.transcription: lii qudtta asmaana laj yaa man lahu humurii
wa qudtta lir rizqa yaa razzaaqu yal laahu

verses.text: فَتَحْتَ لِى كُلَّ بَابٍ كُنْتَ فَاتِحَهُ
verses.transcription: fatahta lii kulla baabin kunta faatihahu
li-awliyaa-ika yaa fattaahu yal laahu
hallamtanil ghayba hattaa sirtu muntabihan
antal haliimul lazii hallamta yal laahu
qabadta yaa qaabidul aswaa-a wan sarafat
lighayri nahwiya kal akdaari yal laahu
basatta yaa baasitul aamaala lii biridan
fashkur mubaasatatid daarayni yal laahu
khafadta yaa khaafidul ahdaa-a lii wa madaw
lighayri nahwii bikhafdin minka yal laahu
rafahta yaa raafihud daarayni martabatii
bilan khifaadi bifadlin minka yal laahu
antal muhizzul lazii laa zamtu hizzatahu
khillan muhazzan wa hibban fiika yal laahu
antal muzillul lazii zallat lihizzatihi
al insu wal jinnu wash shaytaanu yal laahu
antas samiihul lazii naajaytuhu zamanan
wa bil masaraati lii qad judtta yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْبَصِيرُ الَّذِى لِى قَادَ جُمْلَةَ مَا
verses.transcription: antal basiirul lazii lii qaada jumlata maa

verses.text: لِى اخْتَرْتَ دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى مِنْكَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: likh tarta dunyaa wa ukhraa minka yal laahu
hakamta yaa hakamul baaqii bikawniya zaa

verses.text: فَوْزٍ بَمَا غَابِ مِنْ بُشْرَاكَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: fawzin bimaa ghaabi min bushraaka yal laahu
hatalta yaa hadlu ahdaa-ii bighayri liqaa

verses.text: وَلَا ضِرَارٍ وَلِى قَدْ كُنْتَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: walaa diraarin wa lii qad kunta yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ اللَّطِيفُ الَّذِى قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى أَبَدًا
verses.transcription: antal latiiful lazii qad qudtta lii abadan
lutfan hajiiban yaziidul fikra yal laahu
antal khabiirul lazii haayantu khubratahu

verses.text: وَقُدْتَّ لِى مِنْكَ عِلْمَ الْغَيْبِ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: wa qudtta lii minka hilmal ghaybi yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْحَلِيمُ الَّذِى زَحْزَحْتَ جُمْلَتَ مَنْ
verses.transcription: antal haliimul lazii zahzahta jumlata man

verses.text: لَّمْ تَرْضَهُمْ لِى لِغَيْرِى الدَّهْرَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: lam tardahum lii lighayrid dahra yal laahu
antal haziimul lazii baanat hazaamatuhu

verses.text: لِى قُدْتَّ فَضْلًا عَظِيمًا مِّنْكَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: lii qudtta fadlan haziiman minka yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الَّذِى لِى قُدْتَّ مَغْفِرَةً
verses.transcription: antal ghafuurul lazii lii qudta maghfiratan
mahat huyuubii radiitu hanka yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الشَّكُورُ الَّذِى كُلِّى لَدَيْكَ رِضًى
verses.transcription: antash shakuurul lazii kullii ladayka ridan
wa lii shakarta jamiihis sahyi yal laahu
antal haliyyul lazii ahlaytanii abadan
bighayri makrin wa lii hallalta yal laahu
antal kabiirul lazii baanat kabaaratuhu

verses.text: لِى قُدْتَّ مِنْكَ كَبِيرَ الْأَجْرِ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: lii qudtta minka kabiiral ajri yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْحَفِيظُ الَّذِى وَجَّهْتَ فِى أَبَدٍ
verses.transcription: antal hafiizul lazii wajjahta fii abadin
ilaa siwaayal hidaa wa durra yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْمُقِيتُ الَّذِى خَلَّدْتَّ لِى رَغَدًا
verses.transcription: antal muqiitul lazii khalladta lii raghadan
bilaa hisaabin ilal jannaati yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْحَسِيبُ الَّذِى قَدِ اكْتَفَيْتُ بِهِ
verses.transcription: antal hasiibul lazii qadik tafaytu bihi
hanil hidaa wal azaa wal kaddi yal laahu
antal jaliilul lazii saaqat jalaalatuhu
ilaa siwaanal hidad daarayni yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْكَرِيمُ الَّذِى قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى كَرَمًا
verses.transcription: antal kariimul lazii qad qudtta lii karaman
dunyaa wa ukhraa mahat tabshiiri yal laahu
antar raqiibul lazii baanat siyaanatuhu
kulliyyatii han siwar ridwaani yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْمُجِيبُ الَّذِى انْقَادَتْ بِغَيْرِ عَنَآ
verses.transcription: antal mujiibul lazin qaadat bighayri hanaa

verses.text: إِجَابَةٌ مِنْكَ لِى لِى اخْتَرْتَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: ijaabatun minka lii likhtarta yal laahu
wa innakal waasihul baaqii wa lii abadan
wassahta tawsihatan bil hitqi yal laahu
antal hakiimul lazii alaqtanii lisiwaa
maasaa-anii wa mawtas suu-a yal laahu
antal waduudul lazin qaadat mawaddatuhu
lii sarmadan bir ridaa wal qurbi yal laahu
antal majiidul lazii baanat majaadatuhu

verses.text: وَقُدْتَّ لِى مِنْكَ مَجْدًا فَاقَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: wa qudtta lii minka majdan faaqa yal laahu
wa innakal baahisul mubqii bilaa dararin
kafaytanii jumlatal akdaari yal laahu
antash shahiidul lazin qaadat shahaadatuhu
lii bishtiraa-ika minnii zaaka yal laahu

verses.text: يَاحَقُّ لِى اشْهَدْ بِحَقٍ وَامْحُ جُمْلَةَ مَا
verses.transcription: yaa haqqu lish had bihaqqin wamhu jumlata maa

verses.text: لَمْ تَرْضَ لِى مُطْلَقًا بِالْفَضْلِ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: lam tarda lii mutlaqan bil fadli yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْوَكِيلُ الَّذِى قَدِ اكْتَفَيْتُ بِهِ
verses.transcription: antal wakiilul lazii qadik tafaytu bihi

verses.text: فِى الدَّفْعِ وَالْجَلْبِ يَاذَا الْخَلْقِ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: fid dafhi wal jalbi yaa zal khalqi yaa laahu

bayts.text: لبِسْمِ الْإِلَهِ اكْفِنِى الْأَكْدَارَ يَاللَّهُ ۞ صَفِّ الْبَقَآءَ بِهِ لِى فِيكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Nel Nome di Dio: preservami dai torbidi, o Allah; per mezzo di esso rendi pura per me la permanenza in Te, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: In the Name of God: spare me all turbidity, O Allah; through it make pure for me abiding in You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Au Nom de Dieu : préserve-moi des troubles, ô Allah ; par lui rends pure pour moi la permanence en Toi, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَامَنْ لَّهُ الْأَمْرُ يَامَنْ لَّاشَرِيكَ لَهُ ۞ وَسِّعْ وَمَلِّكْ وَأَطْلِقْ فِيكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Colui al quale appartiene il Comando, o Colui che non ha associato: allarga, rendi padrone e libera (me) in Te, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O He to Whom the Command belongs, O He Who has no partner: expand, make master and set (me) free in You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Celui à qui appartient le Commandement, ô Celui qui n'a point d'associé : élargis, rends maître et libère(-moi) en Toi, ô Allah.

bayts.text: وَاجَهْتُكَ الْيَوْمَ يَارَحْمَانُ مُرْتَجِيًا ۞ فَوْزِى بِمَا ثِئْتُ فِى دُنْيَاكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi sono rivolto a Te oggi, o Compassionevole (Ar-Raḥmān), sperando il mio successo in ciò che ho voluto nel Tuo mondo, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: I have turned to You today, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), hoping for my success in what I have willed in Your world, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Je me suis tourné vers Toi aujourd'hui, ô Tout-Miséricordieux (Ar-Raḥmān), espérant mon succès en ce que j'ai voulu dans Ton monde, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الرَّحِيمُ الَّذِى أَرْجُو بِرَحْمَتِهِ ۞ أَنْ لَّآ أُلَاقِىَ ضُرًّا مِّنْكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Misericordioso (Ar-Raḥīm), per la cui misericordia spero di non incontrare danno da Te, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), by Whose mercy I hope to meet no harm from You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Très-Miséricordieux (Ar-Raḥīm), par la miséricorde duquel j'espère ne rencontrer aucun mal de Ta part, ô Allah.

bayts.text: مَلِّكْ يَمِينِى وَقَلْبِى السُّؤْلَ يَامَلِكِى ۞ بِلَا حِسَابٍ بِجُودٍ مِّنْكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Rendi padroni la mia destra e il mio cuore di ciò che chiedo, o mio Re (Al-Malik), senza conto, per generosità da parte Tua, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: Make my right hand and my heart masters of what I ask, O my King (Al-Malik), without reckoning, by generosity from You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Rends maîtres ma droite et mon cœur de ce que je demande, ô mon Roi (Al-Malik), sans compter, par générosité de Ta part, ô Allah.

bayts.text: قَدَّسْتَ سِرِّىَ يَاقُدُّوسُ مُرْتَضِيًا ۞ عَنِّى وَعَنْكَ رَضِيتُ الدَّهْرَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Hai santificato il mio segreto, o Santissimo (Al-Quddūs), compiaciuto di me; e di Te mi sono compiaciuto per sempre, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have sanctified my secret, O Most Holy (Al-Quddūs), well pleased with me; and with You I am well pleased forever, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as sanctifié mon secret, ô Très-Saint (Al-Quddūs), satisfait de moi ; et de Toi je me suis satisfait pour toujours, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ الَّذِى سَلَّمْتَ كُلِّىَ مِنْ ۞ عُيُوبِ نَفْسِى بِطَىٍّ مِّنْكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei la Pace (As-Salām), che hai preservato tutto il mio essere dai difetti della mia anima, ripiegandoli (via) da parte Tua, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Peace (As-Salām), Who have kept my whole being safe from the faults of my soul, folding them (away) from You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es la Paix (As-Salām), qui as préservé tout mon être des défauts de mon âme, en les repliant (au loin) de Ta part, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَامُومِنُ اكْفِ جَنَابِى الضُّرَّ مَعْ كَدَرٍ ۞ وَهَبْ لِىَ الْأَمْنَ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Garante della fede (Al-Muʾmin), preserva la mia persona dal danno e dal torbido, e donami la sicurezza nelle due Dimore, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Giver of faith (Al-Muʾmin), spare my person harm and turbidity, and grant me safety in the two Abodes, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Garant de la foi (Al-Muʾmin), préserve ma personne du mal et du trouble, et donne-moi la sécurité dans les deux Demeures, ô Allah.

bayts.text: وَبِالْمُهَيْمِنِ لِى اشْهَدْ بِاشْتِرَآئِكَ مَا ۞ قَدْ بِعْتُ سِرًّا إِلَى الْجَنَّاتِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: E come Vigilante (Al-Muhaymin) testimonia per me il Tuo aver acquistato ciò che ho venduto in segreto, (in cambio) dei Giardini (Corano 9:111), o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: And as Guardian (Al-Muhaymin) bear witness for me to Your purchase of what I sold in secret, (in exchange) for the Gardens (Qurʾān 9:111), O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Et en tant que Vigilant (Al-Muhaymin) témoigne pour moi de Ton achat de ce que j'ai vendu en secret, (en échange) des Jardins (Coran 9:111), ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الَّذِى أَبْغِى بِعِزَّتِهِ ۞ عِزًّا يُخَلِدُ لِى التَّكْرِيمَ اللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Potente (Al-ʿAzīz), per la cui potenza desidero una potenza che renda eterno per me l'onore: Allah!
translations.en.karamati: You are the Mighty (Al-ʿAzīz), by Whose might I seek a might that makes honour everlasting for me: Allah!
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Puissant (Al-ʿAzīz), par la puissance duquel je désire une puissance qui rende éternel pour moi l'honneur : Allah !

bayts.text: أَجْبَرْتَ لِى إِنَّكَ الْجَبَّارُ دُونَ لِقَآ ۞ كُلَّ الْعِدَى بِالَّذِى لِى اخْتَرْتَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Hai costretto per me — Tu sei l'Irresistibile (Al-Jabbār) — senza scontro, tutti i nemici, con ciò che per me hai scelto, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have compelled for me — You are the Compeller (Al-Jabbār) — without encounter, all the enemies, by what You chose for me, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as contraint pour moi — Tu es le Contraignant (Al-Jabbār) — sans affrontement, tous les ennemis, par ce que Tu as choisi pour moi, ô Allah.

bayts.text: كَفَيْتَنِى كُلَّ ذِى كِبْرِ بِلَا كُلَفٍ ۞ يَامُتَكَبِّرُ رُضْتَ الْكُلَّ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai preservato da ogni superbo, senza fatica; o Superbo (Al-Mutakabbir), hai domato tutti, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have spared me every proud one, without toil; O Supreme in Greatness (Al-Mutakabbir), You have tamed them all, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as préservé de tout orgueilleux, sans peine ; ô Superbe (Al-Mutakabbir), Tu as dompté tous, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَاخَالِقَ الْخَلْقِ لِى اخْلُقْ مَآ أَشَآ أَبَدًا ۞ بِالْبِشْرِ وَالصَّفْوِ وَالرِّضْوَانِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Creatore (Al-Khāliq) della creazione, crea per me ciò che desidero, per sempre, con letizia, purezza e compiacimento, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Creator (Al-Khāliq) of creation, create for me what I wish, forever, with gladness, purity and good pleasure, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Créateur (Al-Khāliq) de la création, crée pour moi ce que je désire, pour toujours, avec allégresse, pureté et agrément, ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَابَارِىءَ الْخَلْقِ قُدْ لِى النَّفْعَ دُونَ أَذًى ۞ وَقُدْ لِىَ الْأَجْرَ لِلْجَنَّاتِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Produttore (Al-Bāriʾ) della creazione, conducimi il beneficio senza danno, e conducimi la ricompensa per i Giardini, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Maker (Al-Bāriʾ) of creation, lead benefit to me without harm, and lead to me the reward for the Gardens, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Producteur (Al-Bāriʾ) de la création, conduis-moi le bienfait sans mal, et conduis-moi la récompense pour les Jardins, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْمُصَوِّرُ خَلِّدْ لِلنَّبِى بُشْرًا ۞ وَصَوِّرَنْ لِّىَ دُونَ الْمَكْرِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Plasmatore (Al-Muṣawwir): rendi eterne per il Profeta buone novelle, e plasma per me (il bene) senza inganno, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Fashioner (Al-Muṣawwir): make glad tidings everlasting for the Prophet, and fashion (good) for me without guile, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Façonneur (Al-Muṣawwir) : rends éternelles pour le Prophète des bonnes nouvelles, et façonne pour moi (le bien) sans ruse, ô Allah.

bayts.text: غَفَرْتَ لِى كُلَّ ذَنْبٍ قَدْ أَتَيْتُ بِهِ ۞ لِى اشْهَدْ بِشُكْرِىَ يَاغَفَّارُ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai perdonato ogni peccato che ho commesso: testimonia per me la mia gratitudine, o Perdonatore (Al-Ghaffār), o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have forgiven me every sin I committed: bear witness for me to my gratitude, O Forgiver (Al-Ghaffār), O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as pardonné tout péché que j'ai commis : témoigne pour moi de ma gratitude, ô Pardonneur (Al-Ghaffār), ô Allah.

bayts.text: قَهَرْتَ لِى رَبِّ أَعْدَآءِى بِلَا سَبَبٍ ۞ مِّنِى حَمِدْتُّكَ يَاقَهَّارُ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Hai domato per me, Signore, i miei nemici, senza causa da parte mia: Ti ho lodato, o Dominatore (Al-Qahhār), o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have subdued my enemies for me, Lord, without cause on my part: I have praised You, O Subduer (Al-Qahhār), O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as dompté pour moi, Seigneur, mes ennemis, sans cause de ma part : je T'ai loué, ô Dominateur (Al-Qahhār), ô Allah.

bayts.text: وَهَبْتَ لِى مِنْكَ سُؤْلًا فَاقَ مَسْئَلَتِى ۞ فَلَكَ شُكْرِىَ يَاوَهَّابُ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai donato da parte Tua una richiesta (esaudita) che ha superato la mia domanda: a Te dunque la mia gratitudine, o Donatore (Al-Wahhāb), o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have given me from Yourself a request (granted) that surpassed my asking: so to You is my gratitude, O Bestower (Al-Wahhāb), O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as donné de Ta part une requête (exaucée) qui a dépassé ma demande : à Toi donc ma gratitude, ô Donateur (Al-Wahhāb), ô Allah.

bayts.text: لِى قُدْتَّ أَثْمَانَ لَجْ يَامَنْ لَّهُ عُمُرِى ۞ وَقُدْتَّ لِى الرِّزْقَ يَارَزَّاقُ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai condotto i prezzi (le ricompense) dell'abisso marino, o Colui al quale (appartiene) la mia vita, e mi hai condotto il sostentamento, o Provveditore (Ar-Razzāq), o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have led to me the prices (the rewards) of the deep sea, O He to Whom my life (belongs), and You have led sustenance to me, O Provider (Ar-Razzāq), O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as conduit les prix (les récompenses) de l'abîme marin, ô Celui à qui (appartient) ma vie, et Tu m'as conduit la subsistance, ô Pourvoyeur (Ar-Razzāq), ô Allah.

bayts.text: فَتَحْتَ لِى كُلَّ بَابٍ كُنْتَ فَاتِحَهُ ۞ لِأَوْلِيَآئِكَ يَافَتَّاحُ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai aperto ogni porta che avevi aperto ai Tuoi santi, o Apritore (Al-Fattāḥ), o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have opened for me every door You had opened for Your saints, O Opener (Al-Fattāḥ), O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as ouvert toute porte que Tu avais ouverte à Tes saints, ô Celui qui ouvre (Al-Fattāḥ), ô Allah.

bayts.text: عَلَّمْتَنِى الْغَيْبَ حَتَّى صِرْتُ مُنْتَبِهًا ۞ أَنْتَ الْعَلِيمُ الَّذِى عَلَّمْتَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi hai insegnato l'invisibile finché sono divenuto desto: Tu sei l'Onnisciente (Al-ʿAlīm) che hai insegnato, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have taught me the unseen until I became awakened: You are the All-Knowing (Al-ʿAlīm) Who have taught, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu m'as enseigné l'invisible jusqu'à ce que je devienne éveillé : Tu es l'Omniscient (Al-ʿAlīm) qui as enseigné, ô Allah.

bayts.text: قَبَضْتَ يَاقَابِضُ الْأَسْوَآءَ وَانْصَرَفَتْ ۞ لِغَيْرِ نَحْوِىَ كَالْأَكْدَارِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Hai stretto, o Colui che restringe (Al-Qābiḍ), i mali, ed essi si sono volti verso altra direzione che la mia, come i torbidi, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have withheld, O Withholder (Al-Qābiḍ), the evils, and they turned toward another direction than mine, like the turbid things, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as resserré, ô Celui qui resserre (Al-Qābiḍ), les maux, et ils se sont tournés vers une autre direction que la mienne, comme les troubles, ô Allah.

bayts.text: بَسَطْتَّ يَابَاسِطُ الْئَامَالَ لِى بِرِضًى ۞ فَاشْكُرْ مُبَاسَطَتِى الدَّارَيْنِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Hai esteso, o Colui che estende (Al-Bāsiṭ), le speranze per me con compiacimento: gradisci dunque la mia confidenza nelle due Dimore, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have expanded, O Expander (Al-Bāsiṭ), hopes for me with good pleasure: so accept my intimacy in the two Abodes, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as étendu, ô Celui qui étend (Al-Bāsiṭ), les espoirs pour moi avec agrément : agrée donc mon intimité dans les deux Demeures, ô Allah.

bayts.text: خَفَضْتَ يَاخَافِضُ الْأَعْدَآءَ لِى وَمَضَوْاْ ۞ لِغَيْرِ نَحْوِى بَخَفْضٍ مِّنْكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Hai abbassato, o Colui che abbassa (Al-Khāfiḍ), i nemici per me, ed essi sono andati verso altra direzione che la mia, con un abbassamento da parte Tua, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have abased, O Abaser (Al-Khāfiḍ), the enemies for me, and they went off toward another direction than mine, by an abasing from You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as abaissé, ô Celui qui abaisse (Al-Khāfiḍ), les ennemis pour moi, et ils sont partis vers une autre direction que la mienne, par un abaissement de Ta part, ô Allah.

bayts.text: رَفَعْتَ يَارَافِعُ الدَّارَيْنِ مَرْتَبَتِى ۞ بِلَا انْخِفَاضِ بِفَضْلٍ مِّنْكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Hai innalzato, o Colui che innalza (Ar-Rāfiʿ), nelle due Dimore il mio rango, senza abbassamento, per grazia da parte Tua, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have raised, O Exalter (Ar-Rāfiʿ), my rank in the two Abodes, without abasement, by grace from You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as élevé, ô Celui qui élève (Ar-Rāfiʿ), dans les deux Demeures mon rang, sans abaissement, par grâce de Ta part, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْمُعِزُّ الَّذِى لَازَمْتُ عِزَّتَهُ ۞ خِلًا مُعَزًّا وَحِبًّا فِيكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei Colui che dà onore (Al-Muʿizz), alla cui potenza mi sono stretto, (io) amico onorato e amato in Te, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Bestower of honour (Al-Muʿizz), to Whose might I have clung, (I) an honoured friend and beloved in You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es Celui qui honore (Al-Muʿizz), à la puissance duquel je me suis attaché, (moi) ami honoré et aimé en Toi, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْمُذِلُّ الَّذِى ذَلَّتْ لِعِزَّتِهِ ۞ الْإِنْسُ وَالْجِنُّ وَالشَّيْطَانُ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei Colui che umilia (Al-Mudhill), alla cui potenza si sono umiliati gli uomini, i jinn e Satana, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Humiliator (Al-Mudhill), before Whose might mankind, the jinn and Satan have been humbled, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es Celui qui humilie (Al-Mudhill), devant la puissance duquel se sont humiliés les hommes, les djinns et Satan, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الَّذِى نَاجَيْتُهُ زَمَنًا ۞ وَبِالْمَسَرَاتِ لِى قَدْ جُدْتَّ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei l'Audiente (As-Samīʿ), con cui ho conversato intimamente a lungo, e di gioie mi sei stato prodigo, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the All-Hearing (As-Samīʿ), with Whom I have conversed intimately for a long time, and with joys You have been lavish to me, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es l'Audient (As-Samīʿ), avec qui j'ai conversé intimement longtemps, et de joies Tu m'as été prodigue, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْبَصِيرُ الَّذِى لِى قَادَ جُمْلَةَ مَا ۞ لِى اخْتَرْتَ دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى مِنْكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Veggente (Al-Baṣīr), che mi ha condotto l'insieme di ciò che hai scelto per me, in questo mondo e nell'altro, da parte Tua, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the All-Seeing (Al-Baṣīr), Who has led to me all that You chose for me, in this world and the next, from You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Clairvoyant (Al-Baṣīr), qui m'a conduit l'ensemble de ce que Tu as choisi pour moi, en ce monde et dans l'autre, de Ta part, ô Allah.

bayts.text: حَكَمْتَ يَاحَكَمُ الْبَاقِى بِكَوْنِىَ ذَا ۞ فَوْزٍ بَمَا غَابِ مِنْ بُشْرَاكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Hai decretato, o Giudice (Al-Ḥakam) Eterno, che io sia possessore di successo, per ciò che è nascosto delle Tue buone novelle, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have decreed, O Everlasting Judge (Al-Ḥakam), that I be a possessor of success, through what is hidden of Your glad tidings, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as décrété, ô Juge (Al-Ḥakam) Éternel, que je sois détenteur du succès, par ce qui est caché de Tes bonnes nouvelles, ô Allah.

bayts.text: عَتَلْتَ يَاعَدْلُ أَعْدَاءِى بِغَيْرِ لِقَآ ۞ وَلَا ضِرَارٍ وَلِى قَدْ كُنْتَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Hai trascinato via, o Giusto (Al-ʿAdl), i miei nemici, senza scontro né danno, e per me sei stato, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You have dragged away, O Just (Al-ʿAdl), my enemies, without encounter or harm, and You have been for me, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu as traîné au loin, ô Juste (Al-ʿAdl), mes ennemis, sans affrontement ni dommage, et pour moi Tu as été, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ اللَّطِيفُ الَّذِى قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى أَبَدًا ۞ لُّطْفًا عَجِيبًا يَزِيدُ الْفِكْرَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Sottile (Al-Laṭīf), che mi hai condotto per sempre una sottile benevolenza mirabile che accresce la riflessione, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Subtle (Al-Laṭīf), Who have led to me forever a wondrous subtle kindness that increases reflection, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Subtil (Al-Laṭīf), qui m'as conduit pour toujours une subtile bienveillance merveilleuse qui accroît la réflexion, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْخَبِيرُ الَّذِى عَايَنْتُ خُبْرَتَهُ ۞ وَقُدْتَّ لِى مِنْكَ عِلْمَ الْغَيْبِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Ben Informato (Al-Khabīr), la cui conoscenza ho visto con i miei occhi, e mi hai condotto da Te la scienza dell'invisibile, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the All-Aware (Al-Khabīr), Whose knowledge I have seen with my eyes, and You have led to me from You the knowledge of the unseen, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Parfaitement Informé (Al-Khabīr), dont j'ai vu de mes yeux la connaissance, et Tu m'as conduit de Ta part la science de l'invisible, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْحَلِيمُ الَّذِى زَحْزَحْتَ جُمْلَتَ مَنْ ۞ لَّمْ تَرْضَهُمْ لِى لِغَيْرِى الدَّهْرَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Clemente (Al-Ḥalīm), che hai allontanato tutti coloro che non hai gradito per me, verso altri, per sempre, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Forbearing (Al-Ḥalīm), Who have removed all those You did not approve for me, toward others, forever, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Longanime (Al-Ḥalīm), qui as écarté tous ceux que Tu n'as pas agréés pour moi, vers d'autres, pour toujours, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِى بَانَتْ عَظَامَتُهُ ۞ لِى قُدْتَّ فَضْلًا عَظِيمًا مِّنْكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei l'Immenso (Al-ʿAẓīm), la cui grandezza è apparsa; mi hai condotto un favore immenso da parte Tua, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Magnificent (Al-ʿAẓīm), Whose greatness has appeared; You have led to me an immense favour from You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es l'Immense (Al-ʿAẓīm), dont la grandeur est apparue ; Tu m'as conduit une faveur immense de Ta part, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الَّذِى لِى قُدْتَّ مَغْفِرَةً ۞ مَّحَتْ عُيُوبِى رَضِيتُ عَنْكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Perdonatore (Al-Ghafūr), che mi hai condotto un perdono che ha cancellato i miei difetti: mi sono compiaciuto di Te, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the All-Forgiving (Al-Ghafūr), Who have led to me a forgiveness that effaced my faults: I am well pleased with You, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Très-Pardonnant (Al-Ghafūr), qui m'as conduit un pardon qui a effacé mes défauts : je me suis satisfait de Toi, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الشَّكُورُ الَّذِى كُلِّى لَدَيْكَ رِضًى ۞ وَلِى شَكَرْتَ جَمِيعِ السَّعْىِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Riconoscente (Ash-Shakūr), presso cui tutto il mio essere è compiacimento, e per me hai gradito tutto lo sforzo, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Appreciative (Ash-Shakūr), with Whom my whole being is good pleasure, and for me You have appreciated all the striving, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Reconnaissant (Ash-Shakūr), auprès de qui tout mon être est agrément, et pour moi Tu as agréé tout l'effort, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْعَلِىُّ الَّذِى أَعْلَيْتَنِى أَبَدًا ۞ بِغَيْرِ مَكْرٍ وَلِى حَلَّلْتَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei l'Altissimo (Al-ʿAlī), che mi hai innalzato per sempre senza inganno, e per me hai reso lecito (il bene), o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Most High (Al-ʿAlī), Who have raised me forever without guile, and for me You have made (good) lawful, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Très-Haut (Al-ʿAlī), qui m'as élevé pour toujours sans ruse, et pour moi Tu as rendu licite (le bien), ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْكَبِيرُ الَّذِى بَانَتْ كَبَارَتُهُ ۞ لِى قُدْتَّ مِنْكَ كَبِيرَ الْأَجْرِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Grande (Al-Kabīr), la cui grandezza è apparsa; mi hai condotto da Te una grande ricompensa, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Great (Al-Kabīr), Whose greatness has appeared; You have led to me from You a great reward, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Grand (Al-Kabīr), dont la grandeur est apparue ; Tu m'as conduit de Ta part une grande récompense, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْحَفِيظُ الَّذِى وَجَّهْتَ فِى أَبَدٍ ۞ إِلَى سِوَاىَ الْعِدَى وَالضُّرَّ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Custode (Al-Ḥafīẓ), che hai rivolto per sempre verso altri che me i nemici e il danno, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Preserver (Al-Ḥafīẓ), Who have turned forever toward others than me the enemies and harm, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Gardien (Al-Ḥafīẓ), qui as tourné pour toujours vers d'autres que moi les ennemis et le mal, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْمُقِيتُ الَّذِى خَلَّدْتَّ لِى رَغَدًا ۞ بِلَا حِسَابٍ إِلَى الْجَنَّاتِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Nutritore (Al-Muqīt), che hai reso perenne per me l'agiatezza, senza conto, fino ai Giardini, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Sustainer (Al-Muqīt), Who have made ease everlasting for me, without reckoning, until the Gardens, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Nourricier (Al-Muqīt), qui as rendu perpétuelle pour moi l'aisance, sans compter, jusqu'aux Jardins, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْحَسِيبُ الَّذِى قَدِ اكْتَفَيْتُ بِهِ ۞ عَنِ الْعِدَى وَالْأَذَى وَالْكَدِّ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei Colui che basta (Al-Ḥasīb), del quale mi sono accontentato, (al riparo) dai nemici, dal danno e dalla fatica, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Sufficient Reckoner (Al-Ḥasīb), with Whom I have been content, (sheltered) from enemies, harm and toil, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es Celui qui suffit (Al-Ḥasīb), dont je me suis contenté, (à l'abri) des ennemis, du mal et de la peine, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْجَلِيلُ الَّذِى سَاقَتْ جَلَالَتُهُ ۞ إِلَى سِوَانَا الْعِدَى الدَّارَيْنِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Maestoso (Al-Jalīl), la cui maestà ha sospinto verso altri che noi i nemici, nelle due Dimore, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Majestic (Al-Jalīl), Whose majesty has driven the enemies toward others than us, in the two Abodes, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Majestueux (Al-Jalīl), dont la majesté a poussé vers d'autres que nous les ennemis, dans les deux Demeures, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْكَرِيمُ الَّذِى قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى كَرَمًا ۞ دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى مَعَ التَّبْشِيرِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Generoso (Al-Karīm), che mi hai condotto generosità in questo mondo e nell'altro, con la buona novella, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Generous (Al-Karīm), Who have led generosity to me in this world and the next, with glad tidings, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Généreux (Al-Karīm), qui m'as conduit la générosité en ce monde et dans l'autre, avec la bonne nouvelle, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الرَّقِيبُ الَّذِى بَانَتْ صِيَانَتُهُ ۞ كُلِّيَّتِى عَنْ سِوَى الرِّضْوَانِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei l'Osservatore (Ar-Raqīb), la cui custodia di tutto il mio essere, da ciò che non è compiacimento, è apparsa, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Watchful (Ar-Raqīb), Whose guarding of my whole being, from all that is not good pleasure, has appeared, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es l'Observateur (Ar-Raqīb), dont la garde de tout mon être, contre ce qui n'est pas agrément, est apparue, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْمُجِيبُ الَّذِى انْقَادَتْ بِغَيْرِ عَنَآ ۞ إِجَابَةٌ مِنْكَ لِى لِى اخْتَرْتَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei Colui che esaudisce (Al-Mujīb), da cui senza fatica si è sottomessa (a me) una risposta da parte Tua, per me, in ciò che per me hai scelto, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Responsive (Al-Mujīb), through Whom without toil an answer from You has yielded (to me), for me, in what You chose for me, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es Celui qui exauce (Al-Mujīb), par qui sans peine s'est soumise (à moi) une réponse de Ta part, pour moi, en ce que Tu as choisi pour moi, ô Allah.

bayts.text: وَإِنَّكَ الْوَاسِعُ الْبَاقِى وَلِى أَبَدًا ۞ وَسَّعْتَ تَوْسِعَةً بِالْعِتْقِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: E in verità Tu sei il Vasto (Al-Wāsiʿ), l'Eterno, e per me, per sempre, hai allargato un'ampiezza con l'affrancamento (dal Fuoco), o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: And truly You are the All-Embracing (Al-Wāsiʿ), the Everlasting, and for me, forever, You have widened a breadth with emancipation (from the Fire), O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Et en vérité Tu es le Vaste (Al-Wāsiʿ), l'Éternel, et pour moi, pour toujours, Tu as élargi une ampleur par l'affranchissement (du Feu), ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْحَكِيمُ الَّذِى أَلَقْتَنِى لِسِوَى ۞ مَاسَائَنِى وَمَحَوْتَ السُّوءَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Saggio (Al-Ḥakīm), che mi hai reso adatto ad altro che ciò che mi affliggeva, e hai cancellato il male, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Wise (Al-Ḥakīm), Who have made me fit for other than what grieved me, and You have effaced the evil, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Sage (Al-Ḥakīm), qui m'as rendu apte à autre chose que ce qui m'affligeait, et Tu as effacé le mal, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْوَدُودُ الَّذِى انْقَادَتْ مَوَدَّتُهُ ۞ لِى سَرْمَدًا بِالرِّضَى وَالْقُرْبِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei l'Amorevole (Al-Wadūd), il cui amore si è dato a me in eterno con il compiacimento e la vicinanza, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Loving (Al-Wadūd), Whose love has yielded to me forever with good pleasure and nearness, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Très-Aimant (Al-Wadūd), dont l'amour s'est donné à moi éternellement avec l'agrément et la proximité, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْمَجِيدُ الَّذِى بَانَتْ مَجَادَتُهُ ۞ وَقُدْتَّ لِى مِنْكَ مَجْدًا فَاقَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Glorioso (Al-Majīd), la cui gloria è apparsa, e mi hai condotto da Te una gloria che (tutto) supera, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Glorious (Al-Majīd), Whose glory has appeared, and You have led to me from You a glory that surpasses (all), O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Glorieux (Al-Majīd), dont la gloire est apparue, et Tu m'as conduit de Ta part une gloire qui (tout) surpasse, ô Allah.

bayts.text: وَإِنَّكَ الْبَاعِثُ الْمُبْقِى بِلَا ضَرَرٍ ۞ كَفَيْتَنِى جُمْلَةَ الْأَكْدَارِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: E in verità Tu sei Colui che risuscita (Al-Bāʿith), che fa perdurare senza danno: mi hai preservato da tutti i torbidi, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: And truly You are the Resurrector (Al-Bāʿith), Who makes endure without harm: You have spared me all turbidity, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Et en vérité Tu es Celui qui ressuscite (Al-Bāʿith), qui fait durer sans dommage : Tu m'as préservé de tous les troubles, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الشَّهِيدُ الَّذِى انْقَادَتْ شَهَادَتُهُ ۞ لِى بِاشْتِرَآئِكَ مِنِّى ذَاكَ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Testimone (Ash-Shahīd), la cui testimonianza si è data a me del Tuo acquisto da me di quello (che ho venduto), o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Witness (Ash-Shahīd), Whose testimony has yielded to me of Your purchase from me of that (which I sold), O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Témoin (Ash-Shahīd), dont le témoignage m'est acquis de Ton achat de moi de cela (que j'ai vendu), ô Allah.

bayts.text: يَاحَقُّ لِى اشْهَدْ بِحَقٍ وَامْحُ جُمْلَةَ مَا ۞ لَمْ تَرْضَ لِى مُطْلَقًا بِالْفَضْلِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: O Verità (Al-Ḥaqq), testimonia per me con verità, e cancella tutto ciò che non hai gradito per me, in assoluto, per grazia, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: O Truth (Al-Ḥaqq), bear witness for me with truth, and efface all that You have not approved for me, absolutely, by grace, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Ô Vérité (Al-Ḥaqq), témoigne pour moi avec vérité, et efface tout ce que Tu n'as pas agréé pour moi, absolument, par grâce, ô Allah.

bayts.text: أَنْتَ الْوَكِيلُ الَّذِى قَدِ اكْتَفَيْتُ بِهِ ۞ فِى الدَّفْعِ وَالْجَلْبِ يَاذَا الْخَلْقِ يَاللَّهُ

translations.it.karamati: Tu sei il Garante (Al-Wakīl), del quale mi sono accontentato nel respingere (il male) e nell'attrarre (il bene), o Signore della creazione, o Allah.
translations.en.karamati: You are the Trustee (Al-Wakīl), with Whom I have been content in warding off (evil) and drawing (good), O Lord of creation, O Allah.
translations.fr.karamati: Tu es le Garant (Al-Wakīl), dont je me suis contenté pour repousser (le mal) et attirer (le bien), ô Seigneur de la création, ô Allah.
